The '''Grand Acquisitions Race''' was a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] scavenger hunt hosted by the [[Chevin Conglomerate]] in hopes of acquiring a series of unique and rare items that they believed would appease the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which was returning to the known galaxy.

==History==
Near the time of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the Chevin Conglomerate orchestrated a scavenger hunt, the Grand Acquisition Race, to retrieve various items of seemingly great value, while hiding their true intentions to the galaxy. To advertise the event, the Conglomerate waited for news broadcast from the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire about the Grand Acquisition Race, and managed to hack the transmission to directly address the galaxy, and potential participants, promising opportunities for personal enrichment to anyone who would care to work for them, calling upon them to reach them out on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="The Grand Acquisitions Race">{{TORcite|type=general|The Grand Acquisitions Race|Nar Shaddaa and Coruscant}}</ref>

The true goal of the Conglomerate was in fact to appeal to the returning [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] fleet, a [[Species/Legends|species]] that had disappeared from the known galaxy several millennia ago. Agents from both the Empire and the Republic, including agent [[Reeho]] from the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]], managed to pierce through the smokescreen surrounding the event, and learn of the true intentions of the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]].<ref name="The Grand Acquisitions Race" />

{{Mission-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Grand Acquisitions Race first appeared as a World Event in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as a lead-up to the Return of the Gree World Event.
